news.title: Assistance needed in Aisle 1: What Missouri WIC families face
news.summary_en: Bursky Public Health and Brown School teams surveyed nearly 2,900 participants and co-developed retailer training to boost nutrition access during pregnancy and early childhood.

news.title: Carolina Caycedo on ‘Growing Deep Roots’
news.summary_en: “Growing Deep Roots,” a one-person show by artist Carolina Caycedo, will open Sept. 9 at the WashU Kemper Art Museum. In this Q&A, Caycedo discusses her work, her interest in migration, just energy transitions and the tenacity of repair.

news.title: ‘The Color Purple’ opens Black Rep’s 50th season
news.summary_en: The Black Rep will launch its 50th anniversary season Sept. 11 with the Tony Award-winning musical “The Color Purple” in WashU’s Edison Theatre.

news.title: WashU faculty receive promotions
news.summary_en: During the 2026 fiscal year, a number of faculty members at Washington University in St. Louis were promoted from associate professor with tenure to full professor.

news.title: Leading the Law Review: A conversation with editor-in-chief Caleb Rogers
news.summary_en: For Caleb Rogers, serving as 2026-2027 editor-in-chief of the Washington University Law Review is both a leadership opportunity and a chance to help shape the scholarship the journal publishes. A third-year law student, Rogers is leading Volume 104 while preparing for a career in commercial finance.

news.title: Sawyer Seminar Lecture Series to launch Sept. 10
news.summary_en: The Center for the Humanities and the Department of African and African American Studies, both in WashU Arts & Sciences, will launch a yearlong Sawyer Seminar on “Black Studies and the Future of the American University” Sept. 10.

news.title: Shake it off
news.summary_en: A grant from the Department of Defense will fund WashU research to make materials that deter aquatic organisms from attaching to surfaces. The work could have applications for anything in wet environments including medical devices for the human body and membranes used in desalinization.

news.title: Expanded Frick Initiatives move civic research into practice
news.summary_en: The gift, combined with a long-term financial commitment from the university, will support programs and grants advancing civil discourse, free and open markets, free speech and personal responsibility.
